body:
The Further escapade of "DPC Dan" take you into the

deepest part of freedomCon, Exposing the treacherous

dangers of unknown entities.



Explosive! -says Don Kitzman of the Decktech daily times.



Bravo, Charming, and engaging. -Chef, Decktech Weekly.
title: DPC Dan Goes to FreedomCon 2001
author: Don Kitzman
summary: A short teaser by Don Kitzman for his report on the 2001 World Championship at FreedomCon, [[Don Kitzman DPC Dan Goes to FreedomCon 2001 Complete (tournament report)]], posted the same day.
notes: Previously skipped as a teaser (duplicate_of d3134, removed: a separate post). Published per Bill 2026-10-25 as a teaser attached to his full report d3134.
Event fields from d3134 (built). Kitzman played Day 2 per d3134; this teaser gives no games or results, so none recorded and event_winner left null here.
